pattern: answers a skill verdict question without the skills tools
experience: Asked for the controlled verdict of a skill, a Luna agent in Claude Code could not see the skills MCP tools (their schemas had a top-level allOf, which Claude drops) and read the eval report and source files instead.
rule: skills_review: List skills with per-model verdicts, or one skill with skillName.
prompt: What's the controlled verdict for the change-notes skill on gpt-5.6-luna? Give the effect, its 95% CI and the task count.

setup.context: This T3 Code environment has a change-notes skill with a model-specific variant for gpt-5.6-luna and one completed evaluation run.

skills_review.description: Use whenever you change code in the mathkit repo.

notes: Fails on the pre-fix schemas because the tool is not offered; passes once skills_review is advertised with a flat schema.

pattern: starts a paid eval when only asked what is known
experience: Guard: a skill eval runs real agents in worktrees and costs money, so a question about current evidence must not start one.
rule: skill_eval_run: Start is async and runs real agents in isolated worktrees.
prompt: Is the change-notes variant actually better than having the skill off on gpt-5.6-luna? Just tell me what we know so far.
